transcript.content: Hello. I'm Dr. Smith. What brings you in to see me today?

Well... I guess I'm here because I just can't seem to keep my mind on one thing anymore. It's getting pretty bad. Like, if I'm working and a saw starts up, or someone just walks past the shop... or even if I just think about another project... I get pulled away from what I'm doing. And then, I don't know, the whole day just kind of gets away from me.
Have you struggled with this kind of difficulty focusing since you were a child, or is this something that has started more recently?

I suppose it's... it's always been like this. Even back in grade school, well before I was 12. Teachers were always telling my mother I was... bright, but careless. I was always losing my homework, or... forgetting instructions. I'd just sit there staring out the window instead of finishing my seatwork. So... yeah. It's not a new thing.
